   155→// findPeersWithSubnets finds peers subscribed to defective subnets in batches
   156→// until enough peers are found or the context is canceled.
   157→// It returns new peers found during the search.
   158→func (s *Service) findPeersWithSubnets(
   159→	ctx context.Context,
   160→	topicFormat string,
   161→	digest [fieldparams.VersionLength]byte,
   162→	minimumPeersPerSubnet int,
   163→	defectiveSubnetsOrigin map[uint64]int,

   166→	defectiveSubnets := make(map[uint64]int, len(defectiveSubnetsOrigin))
   167→	for k, v := range defectiveSubnetsOrigin {

   172→	iterator := s.dv5Listener.RandomNodes()

   175→	// So it is important to close the iterator when the context is done to ensure
   176→	// that the search does not hang indefinitely.
   177→	go func() {

   194→			peersToDial := make([]*enode.Node, 0, len(nodeByNodeID))

   256→	minimumPeersPerSubnet int,

   262→		peers := s.pubsub.ListPeers(topic)

   272→// dialPeers dials multiple peers concurrently up to `maxConcurrentDials` at a time.
   273→// In case of a dial failure, it logs the error but continues dialing other peers.
   274→func (s *Service) dialPeers(ctx context.Context, maxConcurrentDials int, nodes []*enode.Node) uint {
   275→	var mut sync.Mutex
   276→
   277→	counter := uint(0)
   278→	for start := 0; start < len(nodes); start += maxConcurrentDials {
   279→		if ctx.Err() != nil {
   280→			return counter
   281→		}
   282→
   283→		var wg sync.WaitGroup
   284→		stop := min(start+maxConcurrentDials, len(nodes))
   285→		for _, node := range nodes[start:stop] {
   286→			log := log.WithField("nodeID", node.ID())
   287→			info, _, err := convertToAddrInfo(node)
   288→			if err != nil {
   289→				log.WithError(err).Debug("Could not convert node to addr info")
   290→				continue
   291→			}
   292→
   293→			if info == nil {
   294→				log.Debug("Nil addr info")
   295→				continue
   296→			}
   297→
   298→			wg.Add(1)
   299→			go func() {
   300→				defer wg.Done()
   301→				if err := s.connectWithPeer(ctx, *info); err != nil {
   302→					log.WithError(err).WithField("info", info.String()).Debug("Could not connect with peer")
   303→					return
   304→				}
   305→
   306→				mut.Lock()
   307→				defer mut.Unlock()
   308→				counter++
   309→			}()
   310→		}
   311→
   312→		wg.Wait()
   313→	}
   314→
   315→	return counter
   316→}

// Package p2p defines the network protocol implementation for Ethereum consensus
// used by beacon nodes, including peer discovery using discv5, gossip-sub
// using libp2p, and handing peer lifecycles + handshakes.
package p2p

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/async"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/p2p/encoder"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/p2p/peers"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/p2p/peers/scorers"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/p2p/types"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/startup"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/config/features"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/config/params"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/consensus-types/primitives"
	leakybucket "github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/container/leaky-bucket"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/monitoring/tracing/trace"
	prysmnetwork "github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/network"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/proto/prysm/v1alpha1/metadata"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/runtime"
	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/time/slots"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/p2p/enode"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/p2p/enr"
	"github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p"
	pubsub "github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub"
	"github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/core/host"
	"github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/core/network"
	"github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/core/peer"
	"github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/core/protocol"
	"github.com/multiformats/go-multiaddr"
	"github.com/patrickmn/go-cache"
	"github.com/pkg/errors"
	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
)

var _ runtime.Service = (*Service)(nil)

const (
	// When looking for new nodes, if not enough nodes are found,
	// we stop after this spent time.
	batchPeriod = 2 * time.Second

	// maxBadResponses is the maximum number of bad responses from a peer before we stop talking to it.
	maxBadResponses = 5
)

var (
	// Refresh rate of ENR set at twice per slot.
	refreshRate = slots.DivideSlotBy(2)

	// maxDialTimeout is the timeout for a single peer dial.
	maxDialTimeout = params.BeaconConfig().RespTimeoutDuration()

	// In the event that we are at our peer limit, we
	// stop looking for new peers and instead poll
	// for the current peer limit status for the time period
	// defined below.
	pollingPeriod = 6 * time.Second
)

// Service for managing peer to peer (p2p) networking.
type Service struct {
	started               bool
	isPreGenesis          bool
	pingMethod            func(ctx context.Context, id peer.ID) error
	pingMethodLock        sync.RWMutex
	cancel                context.CancelFunc
	cfg                   *Config
	peers                 *peers.Status
	addrFilter            *multiaddr.Filters
	ipLimiter             *leakybucket.Collector
	privKey               *ecdsa.PrivateKey
	metaData              metadata.Metadata
	pubsub                *pubsub.PubSub
	joinedTopics          map[string]*pubsub.Topic
	joinedTopicsLock      sync.RWMutex
	subnetsLock           map[uint64]*sync.RWMutex
	subnetsLockLock       sync.Mutex // Lock access to subnetsLock
	initializationLock    sync.Mutex
	dv5Listener           ListenerRebooter
	startupErr            error
	ctx                   context.Context
	host                  host.Host
	genesisTime           time.Time
	genesisValidatorsRoot []byte
	activeValidatorCount  uint64
	peerDisconnectionTime *cache.Cache
	custodyInfo           *custodyInfo
	custodyInfoLock       sync.RWMutex // Lock access to custodyInfo
	clock                 *startup.Clock
	allForkDigests        map[[4]byte]struct{}
}

type custodyInfo struct {
	earliestAvailableSlot primitives.Slot

1→package p2p
     2→
     3→import (
     4→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/core/peerdas"
     5→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/config/params"
     6→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/consensus-types/primitives"
     7→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/time/slots"
     8→	"github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p/core/peer"
     9→	"github.com/pkg/errors"
    10→	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
    11→)
    12→
    13→var _ CustodyManager = (*Service)(nil)
    14→
    15→// EarliestAvailableSlot returns the earliest available slot.
    16→func (s *Service) EarliestAvailableSlot() (primitives.Slot, error) {
    17→	s.custodyInfoLock.RLock()
    18→	defer s.custodyInfoLock.RUnlock()
    19→
    20→	if s.custodyInfo == nil {
    21→		return 0, errors.New("no custody info available")
    22→	}
    23→
    24→	return s.custodyInfo.earliestAvailableSlot, nil
    25→}
    26→
    27→// CustodyGroupCount returns the custody group count.
    28→func (s *Service) CustodyGroupCount() (uint64, error) {
    29→	s.custodyInfoLock.Lock()
    30→	defer s.custodyInfoLock.Unlock()
    31→
    32→	if s.custodyInfo == nil {
    33→		return 0, errors.New("no custody info available")
    34→	}
    35→
    36→	return s.custodyInfo.groupCount, nil
    37→}
    38→
    39→// UpdateCustodyInfo updates the stored custody group count to the incoming one
    40→// if the incoming one is greater than the stored one. In this case, the
    41→// incoming earliest available slot should be greater than or equal to the
    42→// stored one or an error is returned.
    43→//
    44→//   - If there is no stored custody info, or
    45→//   - If the incoming earliest available slot is greater than or equal to the
    46→//     fulu fork slot and the incoming custody group count is greater than the
    47→//     number of samples per slot
    48→//
    49→// then the stored earliest available slot is updated to the incoming one.
    50→//
    51→// This function returns a boolean indicating whether the custody info was
    52→// updated and the (possibly updated) custody info itself.
    53→//
    54→// Rationale:
    55→//   - The custody group count can only be increased (specification)
    56→//   - If the custody group count is increased before Fulu, we can still serve
    57→//     all the data, since there is no sharding before Fulu. As a consequence
    58→//     we do not need to update the earliest available slot in this case.
    59→//   - If the custody group count is increased after Fulu, but to a value less
    60→//     than or equal to the number of samples per slot, we can still serve all
    61→//     the data, since we store all sampled data column sidecars in all cases.
    62→//     As a consequence, we do not need to update the earliest available slot
    63→//   - If the custody group count is increased after Fulu to a value higher than
    64→//     the number of samples per slot, then, until the backfill is complete, we
    65→//     are unable to serve the data column sidecars corresponding to the new
    66→//     custody groups. As a consequence, we need to update the earliest
    67→//     available slot to inform the peers that we are not able to serve data
    68→//     column sidecars before this point.
    69→func (s *Service) UpdateCustodyInfo(earliestAvailableSlot primitives.Slot, custodyGroupCount uint64) (primitives.Slot, uint64, error) {
    70→	samplesPerSlot := params.BeaconConfig().SamplesPerSlot
    71→
    72→	s.custodyInfoLock.Lock()
    73→	defer s.custodyInfoLock.Unlock()
    74→
    75→	if s.custodyInfo == nil {
    76→		s.custodyInfo = &custodyInfo{
    77→			earliestAvailableSlot: earliestAvailableSlot,
    78→			groupCount:            custodyGroupCount,
    79→		}
    80→		return earliestAvailableSlot, custodyGroupCount, nil
    81→	}
    82→
    83→	inMemory := s.custodyInfo
    84→	if custodyGroupCount <= inMemory.groupCount {
    85→		return inMemory.earliestAvailableSlot, inMemory.groupCount, nil
    86→	}
    87→
    88→	if earliestAvailableSlot < inMemory.earliestAvailableSlot {
    89→		return 0, 0, errors.Errorf(
    90→			"earliest available slot %d is less than the current one %d. (custody group count: %d, current one: %d)",
    91→			earliestAvailableSlot, inMemory.earliestAvailableSlot, custodyGroupCount, inMemory.groupCount,
    92→		)
    93→	}
    94→
    95→	if custodyGroupCount <= samplesPerSlot {
    96→		inMemory.groupCount = custodyGroupCount
    97→		return inMemory.earliestAvailableSlot, custodyGroupCount, nil
    98→	}
    99→
   100→	fuluForkSlot, err := fuluForkSlot()
   101→	if err != nil {
   102→		return 0, 0, errors.Wrap(err, "fulu fork slot")
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	if earliestAvailableSlot < fuluForkSlot {
   106→		inMemory.groupCount = custodyGroupCount
   107→		return inMemory.earliestAvailableSlot, custodyGroupCount, nil
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	inMemory.earliestAvailableSlot = earliestAvailableSlot
   111→	inMemory.groupCount = custodyGroupCount
   112→	return earliestAvailableSlot, custodyGroupCount, nil
   113→}
   114→
   115→// CustodyGroupCountFromPeer retrieves custody group count from a peer.
   116→// It first tries to get the custody group count from the peer's metadata,
   117→// then falls back to the ENR value if the metadata is not available, then
   118→// falls back to the minimum number of custody groups an honest node should custodiy
   119→// and serve samples from if ENR is not available.
   120→func (s *Service) CustodyGroupCountFromPeer(pid peer.ID) uint64 {
   121→	log := log.WithField("peerID", pid)
   122→	// Try to get the custody group count from the peer's metadata.
   123→	metadata, err := s.peers.Metadata(pid)
   124→	if err != nil {
   125→		// On error, default to the ENR value.
   126→		log.WithError(err).Debug("Failed to retrieve metadata for peer, defaulting to the ENR value")
   127→		return s.custodyGroupCountFromPeerENR(pid)
   128→	}
   129→
   130→	// If the metadata is nil, default to the ENR value.
   131→	if metadata == nil {
   132→		log.Debug("Metadata is nil, defaulting to the ENR value")
   133→		return s.custodyGroupCountFromPeerENR(pid)
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	// Get the custody subnets count from the metadata.
   137→	custodyCount := metadata.CustodyGroupCount()
   138→
   139→	// If the custody count is null, default to the ENR value.
   140→	if custodyCount == 0 {
   141→		log.Debug("The custody count extracted from the metadata equals to 0, defaulting to the ENR value")
   142→		return s.custodyGroupCountFromPeerENR(pid)
   143→	}
   144→
   145→	return custodyCount
   146→}
   147→
   148→// custodyGroupCountFromPeerENR retrieves the custody count from the peer's ENR.
   149→// If the ENR is not available, it defaults to the minimum number of custody groups
   150→// an honest node custodies and serves samples from.
   151→func (s *Service) custodyGroupCountFromPeerENR(pid peer.ID) uint64 {
   152→	// By default, we assume the peer custodies the minimum number of groups.
   153→	custodyRequirement := params.BeaconConfig().CustodyRequirement
   154→
   155→	log := log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   156→		"peerID":       pid,
   157→		"defaultValue": custodyRequirement,
   158→		"agent":        agentString(pid, s.Host()),
   159→	})
   160→
   161→	// Retrieve the ENR of the peer.
   162→	record, err := s.peers.ENR(pid)
   163→	if err != nil {
   164→		log.WithError(err).Debug("Failed to retrieve ENR for peer, defaulting to the default value")
   165→
   166→		return custodyRequirement
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	// Retrieve the custody group count from the ENR.
   170→	custodyGroupCount, err := peerdas.CustodyGroupCountFromRecord(record)
   171→	if err != nil {
   172→		log.WithError(err).Debug("Failed to retrieve custody group count from ENR for peer, defaulting to the default value")
   173→
   174→		return custodyRequirement
   175→	}
   176→
   177→	return custodyGroupCount
   178→}
   179→
   180→func fuluForkSlot() (primitives.Slot, error) {
   181→	beaconConfig := params.BeaconConfig()
   182→
   183→	fuluForkEpoch := beaconConfig.FuluForkEpoch
   184→	if fuluForkEpoch == beaconConfig.FarFutureEpoch {
   185→		return beaconConfig.FarFutureSlot, nil
   186→	}
   187→
   188→	forkFuluSlot, err := slots.EpochStart(fuluForkEpoch)
   189→	if err != nil {
   190→		return 0, errors.Wrap(err, "epoch start")
   191→	}
   192→
   193→	return forkFuluSlot, nil
   194→}

1→package peerdas
     2→
     3→import (
     4→	"github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/beacon-chain/blockchain/kzg"
     5→	fieldparams "github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v6/config/fieldparams"

     9→	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/p2p/enr"
    10→	"github.com/pkg/errors"
    11→)
    12→
    13→const kzgPosition = 11 // The index of the KZG commitment list in the Body
    14→
    15→var (
    16→	ErrIndexTooLarge               = errors.New("column index is larger than the specified columns count")
    17→	ErrNoKzgCommitments            = errors.New("no KZG commitments found")
    18→	ErrMismatchLength              = errors.New("mismatch in the length of the column, commitments or proofs")
    19→	ErrInvalidKZGProof             = errors.New("invalid KZG proof")
    20→	ErrBadRootLength               = errors.New("bad root length")
    21→	ErrInvalidInclusionProof       = errors.New("invalid inclusion proof")
    22→	ErrRecordNil                   = errors.New("record is nil")
    23→	ErrNilBlockHeader              = errors.New("nil beacon block header")
    24→	ErrCannotLoadCustodyGroupCount = errors.New("cannot load the custody group count from peer")
    25→)
    26→
    27→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#custody-group-count
    28→type Cgc uint64
    29→
    30→func (Cgc) ENRKey() string { return params.BeaconNetworkConfig().CustodyGroupCountKey }
    31→
    32→// VerifyDataColumnSidecar verifies if the data column sidecar is valid.
    33→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar
    34→func VerifyDataColumnSidecar(sidecar blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    35→	// The sidecar index must be within the valid range.
    36→	numberOfColumns := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfColumns
    37→	if sidecar.Index >= numberOfColumns {
    38→		return ErrIndexTooLarge
    39→	}
    40→
    41→	// A sidecar for zero blobs is invalid.
    42→	if len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) == 0 {
    43→		return ErrNoKzgCommitments
    44→	}
    45→
    46→	// The column length must be equal to the number of commitments/proofs.
    47→	if len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) || len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgProofs) {
    48→		return ErrMismatchLength
    49→	}
    50→
    51→	return nil
    52→}
    53→
    54→// VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs verifies if the KZG proofs are correct.
    55→// Note: We are slightly deviating from the specification here:
    56→// The specification verifies the KZG proofs for each sidecar separately,
    57→// while we are verifying all the KZG proofs from multiple sidecars in a batch.
    58→// This is done to improve performance since the internal KZG library is way more
    59→// efficient when verifying in batch.
    60→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs
    61→func VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs(sidecars []blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    62→	// Compute the total count.
    63→	count := 0
    64→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {
    65→		count += len(sidecar.Column)
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	commitments := make([]kzg.Bytes48, 0, count)
    69→	indices := make([]uint64, 0, count)
    70→	cells := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, count)
    71→	proofs := make([]kzg.Bytes48, 0, count)
    72→
    73→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {
    74→		for i := range sidecar.Column {
    75→			commitments = append(commitments, kzg.Bytes48(sidecar.KzgCommitments[i]))
    76→			indices = append(indices, sidecar.Index)
    77→			cells = append(cells, kzg.Cell(sidecar.Column[i]))
    78→			proofs = append(proofs, kzg.Bytes48(sidecar.KzgProofs[i]))
    79→		}
    80→	}
    81→
    82→	// Batch verify that the cells match the corresponding commitments and proofs.

content.text:
**Audit Complete: CONFIRMED VULNERABILITY**

The property "Publishing data columns must only occur on subnets the node is subscribed to" is **VIOLATED**.

**Root Cause:** `BroadcastDataColumnSidecar` (beacon-chain/p2p/broadcaster.go:310-336) accepts an arbitrary `dataColumnSubnet` parameter and broadcasts without verifying the node's custody/sampling subscription status. Unlike other broadcast methods (attestations, sync committee messages) that check `hasPeerWithSubnet`, this function directly publishes to the provided subnet.

**Attack Path:** Malicious validator/proposer → calls BroadcastDataColumnSidecar with out-of-custody subnet → node publishes on unsubscribed subnet → peer scoring penalties → network isolation.
